facts.claim: Le Champlain (Ponant): Entered service 2018; 37,000 GT; 184 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 217 m length; Explorer class.
Le Champlain is the second ship of the Ponant Explorers-class of cruise ships operated by Ponant.
Each member of the class has been allocated the name of a famous French explorer, and Le Champlain is named after Samuel de Champlain, "The Father of New France".
